audit.why: Lane difficulty (EVEN, 5.5/10) is reasonable: Vel'Koz out-ranges Galio's Winds of War (Q) and wins the poke war, but Galio's Justice Punch (E) into Shield of Durand (W) taunt is a real all-in threat with no dash of Vel'Koz's own to answer it besides E/Flash.

Power spikes track correctly: Vel'Koz's poke dominates levels 1-5, Tectonic Disruption (E, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s CD) answers Justice Punch, and Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) out-ranges Galio's Justice Punch (E, 810 range) at level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Galio's Justice Punch and Vel'Koz's Tectonic Disruption as the key cooldowns but gives no actual numbers, and nowhere does the page state that Galio's Shield of Durand (W) and Hero's Entrance (R) can cancel Vel'Koz's Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) channel — a missing-interaction rule.
audit.why: Vel'Koz's R is a 2.5s channel interruptible by any hard CC (per ownerKit flags.channel). Galio's W taunt (18/17/16/15/14s CD) and R knockup both qualify. Real cooldown numbers make the cooldowns field concrete per the audit spec, and the channel vulnerability is the single highest-value missing interaction in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns and folded in the channel-punish warning.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Tectonic Disruption answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Galio's Justice Punch (E) is 11-7s CD by rank; no engage while it's down — read it before every step-up. - Your Tectonic Disruption (E) is 12-10s; one disaster per cooldown. - His W/R cancels your R channel — beam only once his CC is spent.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: Rotate the pick: catch his duo split by an angle, land Q-E-W before Galio can taunt one off.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Standing at Justice Punch range mid-charge — his taunt cancels your channel outright.

notes: Both flagged suspectNames are false positives: 'Tectonic Disruption' is Vel'Koz's real E name and 'Hero's Entrance' is Galio's real R name (both confirmed against the kit files) — no correction needed.
